In line with the October projection – under the assumption of constant NBP interest rates – there is a 50-percent probability of inflation running in the range of 2.4-2.6% in 2010 (as compared to 2.2-3.0% in the July projection), 2.3-4.0% in 2011 (as compared to 2.0-3.8%) and 1.8-3.7% in 2012 (as compared to 2.2-3.7%).
